facts.value: Credits must have been earned no more than five calendar years before the start of the master's degree.
An application for credit transfer must be submitted with the application for admission.
A detailed transcript of all previously completed credits at another university must be attached to the application.
Credits from a bachelor's degree cannot be credited towards the master's program.
The ranking of applicants is based on a value that consists of 60% from the grade of the previous degree and 40% from the grade of the project outline.

The evaluation of the project outline considers the external quality, presentation, motivation for study, intended career perspective, and previous knowledge in education economics and quantitative methods.
The application is done through an online system provided and operated by uni-assist e.V.
Required documents such as CV and transcripts can be uploaded digitally via the application portal.
Applicants with foreign qualifications must prove German language skills at the level of the Central Intermediate Examination (C1 level).
Each provisionally accepted applicant must pass the DSH-2 examination before the beginning of the lecture period.
Conditional acceptance may occur pending additional bachelor's program completion if applying with a business bachelor's degree.
Additional documents must be submitted by July 15 if the bachelor's degree certificate is not yet available.
The semester fee for the master's program is approximately €350 per semester.
Since the winter semester 2008/09, there are no tuition fees.
Final acceptance will occur after submitting the bachelor's degree certificate within a specified deadline.
All examination results for the bachelor's program must be successfully completed by the summer semester preceding the start of the master's program.
